transientRecovery.behavior: Account Listings New loads seller inventory options inside the default-safe fresh-write loader, merges an explicit Inventory-owned item snapshot when the Marketplace supply mirror is missing the handoff item, and renders a route-owned empty inventory fallback when valid post-write supply reads are still catching up.

transientRecovery.behavior: Committed import rows link to Account Listings New with an explicit inventoryItemId; the loader preserves normal Marketplace supply options but merges the exact Inventory-owned item snapshot when the Marketplace supply mirror is missing the handoff item.

Account Listings New checks Listing stock readiness with exact Marketplace supply-location freshness and falls back to asking for ship-from details instead of throwing a generic page error while valid post-write supply reads catch up.

Account Listings loads Seller Listing Availability inside the default-safe fresh-write loader, so availability toggles redirect with a Marketplace receipt and the destination waits on the availability page before showing the account-wide control.

Submitted Offer detail uses exact Marketplace offer-page freshness and treats valid fresh-write not-found, projection freshness timeout, and opaque gateway timeout responses as temporary submitted-offer preparation while the offer projection catches up.

Offer Match detail redirects with the AcceptOffer command receipt; the destination loader forwards it to the offer-page read and treats valid fresh-write not-found and projection freshness timeout responses as temporary offer-match preparation while the offer projection catches up.

Decline and mute offer-match actions redirect to Offer Matches with a Marketplace commit receipt; the list loader waits on offer seller-control projections before rendering the seller's remaining matches.

Review submission redirects with the SubmitReview command receipt; the account review loader forwards it to the review detail read and treats valid fresh-write not-found, projection freshness timeout, and opaque gateway timeout responses as temporary review preparation while the review projection catches up.

visibleDestination.description: Marketplace configured-fetch clients return command-owned listing and terms snapshots and attach response consistency metadata for route actions that redirect to fresh detail or list reads.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The client returns the API response body with non-enumerable command receipt metadata from attachResponseMetadata; listing drafts, listing commands, photo uploads, and fee previews are scoped to the command response and do not claim downstream projection freshness.

visibleDestination.description: Listing API commands return command-owned ids, versions, statuses, draft intent snapshots, or fee quote snapshots; browser form destinations use the returned receipt for fresh detail/list reads.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Listing create/update/publish/pause/withdraw and availability commands respond from the committed command result with id/version/status; draft intent and claim routes return the draft snapshot; fee preview routes return the computed terms snapshot, with stale fee quote responses carrying the current quote.

visibleDestination.description: Offer API commands return command-owned id/version/status snapshots; submitted-offer, accepted-offer, declined-offer, and muted-buyer browser destinations use the receipt for fresh offer reads.

proof.authoritativeResponse: SubmitOffer returns id/version/status=submitted, AcceptOffer returns id/version/status=accepted, DeclineOfferMatch returns id/version/status=declined, and MuteBuyerOffers returns id/version/status=muted directly from the command result; stale fee quote failures return the current quote snapshot instead of rendering stale acceptance terms.

transientRecovery.behavior: Decline and mute offer-match forms redirect to Offer Matches with a Marketplace commit receipt; the list loader forwards afterWrite to the offer match read so seller controls hide declined or muted matches only after the offer projection catches up.

visibleDestination.description: Review API commands return command-owned review id/version/status snapshots; review submission routes use the receipt for a fresh review detail read.

proof.authoritativeResponse: SubmitReview, UpdateReview, and WithdrawReview respond from the command result with review id, stream version, and status before any review read-model projection is consulted.

transientRecovery.behavior: Listing detail forms redirect back to the listing detail with a Marketplace commit receipt; the loader forwards afterWrite to the listing API and treats fresh not-found or projection freshness timeout as temporary listing preparation while the listing projection catches up.

Seller Listing Availability toggles redirect to Account Listings with a Marketplace receipt; the destination loader forwards it to availability and list reads before rendering the account-wide status control.

The create listing form submits through the dedicated Account Listings New route and redirects to the new listing detail with a Marketplace commit receipt; the detail loader waits on the listing projection before rendering price, quantity, photos, and status.

visibleDestination.description: Bulk pause/withdraw submits the selected listing ids to the Account Listings route action, which batches the existing per-listing pause/withdraw commands and returns a per-row outcome list without redirecting; React Router revalidates the Account Listings loader on the same response, refreshing the table, status badges, and status counts from the Marketplace listings read model.

proof.correction: Each selected listing's outcome (succeeded or failed, with the command error message) renders inline immediately from the action response; if a succeeded row's status has not yet caught up in the revalidated table read, the outcome banner stays visible until the next projection-backed reload reflects the new status, and failed rows leave the listing's status and badge unchanged so the seller can retry.

transientRecovery.behavior: Accept Offer redirects back to the Offer Match detail with the AcceptOffer receipt; the detail loader forwards afterWrite to the offer read and treats fresh-write not-found or projection freshness timeout as temporary offer-match preparation while the offer projection catches up.

Marketplace Offer Match source-list forms post selected offer snapshots to the Checkout-owned Sell List action; Checkout redirects to Account Sell List with its receipt and waits on sell-list line and confirmation projections.

Purchase and sale review forms submit through Marketplace review route support and redirect to review detail with a SubmitReview receipt; the review detail loader waits on marketplace_review_pages before rendering the submitted rating and feedback.

visibleDestination.description: Report Listing returns the command-owned report id, version, target, distinct report count, threshold, and auto-unlisted flag. The public listing action redirects with a static reported marker and does not depend on a just-written projection.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Report listing writes return the report submission snapshot directly from the Marketplace report command and the immediate event-stream threshold count.
